lmto_asa_code.name: LMTO-ASA electronic structure code (e.g., Questaal suite)

access.notes: Open-source implementation of the linearised muffin-tin orbitals in the atomic sphere approximation. Must support spin-polarised calculations and the ability to modify potentials on a per-orbital basis.

lmto_asa_code.notes: Alternative Stuttgart LMTO-ASA code or a custom implementation based on the formalism described in the problem background is also acceptable.

crystal_structures.name: Crystal structures of NiO, MnO, FeO, CoO (NaCl type, antiferromagnetic AF2 ordering)

access.notes: Lattice constants and atomic positions for the four monoxides in the antiferromagnetic type‑II (AF2) structure are standard and available from inorganic crystal structure databases (e.g., ICSD) or the crystallographic literature.

crystal_structures.notes: The agent must use the correct magnetic cell for each compound; all four oxides are described in the paper with AF2 ordering.
